title: Doug Wolf, first OGA director with NRO career

tellings.quote: Do you know Doug Wolf additionally spent 16 years in the NRO

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a man named Doug Wolf, who he says became director of a secretive government office known by the initials OGA around 2003, an office UAPGerb ties to the Pentagon's hidden UFO programme. UAPGerb says Wolf had spent 16 years at the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites, making him the first head of that office with such a background. If true, it would link the office's UFO work to satellite spying.
